comment: K1019’s bigram-specific SGD calibration supported AdamW D over the SGD candidates. E’s tenfold higher rate than C on the same transformer supported E over C. A’s much higher effective rate than B on the same GRU supported A over B. The cross-architecture ordering required accounting for initialization: weakly trained GRUs can retain lower CE than weakly trained transformers, so C’s nominal progress did not imply it beat B. K1012 helped avoid treating progress estimates as baseline-loss estimates; K1071 supported D’s moderate adaptive rate. No new general rule was established.
